about: Unofficial Patch by Werner Spahl (Wesp5): our prepared 11.5 pack. Release 0.1.3 ships 11.5 only; the latest patch comes with 0.2.0. The Companion downloads it, checks its sha256 and installs it.

installers.name: Unofficial Patch 11.5
installers.note: Our prepared 11.5 pack from release 0.1.2. Keeps every save made with 0.1.0 to 0.1.2, on the Quest and the PC.
